connector.name: Munimind MCP
connector.registryDescription: Query 2,500+ NYC civic datasets (zoning, deeds, permits, violations, meetings) via Claude.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package munimind-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.munimind, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MUNIMIND_API_KEY
env.description: MuniMind API key from https://munimind.com/developers — first 5,000 credits free

env.name: MUNIMIND_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override API base URL (defaults to https://api.munimind.com)
